image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a custom chrome alloy car wheel mounted on a red vehicle. The wheel features large, stylized Y-spokes with a highly reflective chrome finish. A black rubber tire surrounds the rim. The background shows the red body panel of the car with some illegible white text decals and strong lens flare/lighting effects.

artifact_observations.reasoning: White decal text on the car body is illegible and distorted, resembling AI-generated pseudo-text rather than clear branding.
Reflections in the chrome are overly saturated and slightly smeared, lacking the crisp environmental mapping expected in a real photograph.
The boundary between the rubber tire and the metal rim lacks a distinct bead seat lip; the materials appear to merge or bleed into each other without a physical locking mechanism.
The wheel appears to float above the ground; there is no visible contact patch deformation or realistic shadow grounding the heavy object to the surface.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the geometric relationship between the tire and the ground. Does the tire deform slightly at the bottom? Is there a shadow? Look closely at where the rubber meets the metal rim; there should be a distinct lip or gap, not a blurry transition.
